arguments.command:

from events.dedup import Deduper
x=Deduper(10)
print(x.seen('job-1',0), x.seen('job-1',10), len(x))
y=Deduper(10)
for i in range(100): y.seen(i, i)
print(len(y))
y.seen(100, 100)
print(len(y))
